bio: Usd al-Ghaba notes that Abu 'Umar (al-Isti'ab) gives the long lineage Hazzal ibn Dhi'ab ibn Yazid ibn Kulayb ibn 'Amir of Aslam, while Ibn Manda and Abu Nu'aym call him Hazzal ibn Yazid al-Aslami.
